len(s) counts bytes, and s[:n] cuts bytes. "é" is two bytes, and an emoji is four. You need to count characters, and cut at the byte offset where character n+1 starts.
for i := range s gives you the byte offset i of each rune in turn. Count runes as you go; when the count reaches n, return s[:i] + "…". If the loop ends first, the string was short enough: return s.
